live only with a radio open (and a press would open the system microphone): never pressed in a bounded run; the family test presses it

drawn only with the TONE input chosen, which needs a radio open; the family test commits a tone

press PTT with no radio open (it is greyed): state transmit.sent.0a03 == 0, transmit.ptt == 0, txKeyed == 0 - nothing is held or sent; THE HOLD ITSELF IS NOT EXERCISED (no transmitter on this machine): the family test holds, drags off and releases it, the host test drives every interlock

a caption with a tooltip, not a control

click OFF; state fact.tx.plugin.refusal == 0 (the refusal is cleared)
click DATA (flat) twice; state fact.tx.plugin.dataFlat == 0 then 1; expect checked false then true
